summary: The story's security-relevant surface is path handling and refusal behaviour. check_epic_contract resolves every source_ref against the CALLER's base rather than repo_root(), refusing absolute paths and any reference that escapes the repository — a defect found in review, since resolving against the tool's own checkout would accept references that do not exist in the target and reject ones that do. doctor was hardened against malformed roadmap JSON: null, a bare array and non-object items are reported rather than raising, because doctor is what someone runs when the project is already broken.

non_blocking_findings.summary: autoreview's secret detector reads the delegation ledger's 32-hex launch_id as a credential, so every local review this session needed the ledger stashed first — five times. A launch- prefix on the id would end it permanently for every scanner.

residual_risks: The --no-spec carve-out survives intact and is now covered by a test it never had. Decision 0014 puts authorization at plan save, and plans.py already refuses spec-debt stories, so the hatch is a designed path rather than a hole.
